text:
Hi all, I am on the B1 visa and my husband is insured through Clalit. We are at his home branch in Tel Aviv now and they are struggling to understand how to register me for the partner insurance. We followed the AIC site instructions and have the policy printed and with us. The clerk is confused and saying I need to have a temporary TZ in order to register for this which I know isn’t the case.

For those on Clalit partner insurance, is there anything more we can tell them in order to help them understand this specific process? Thank you for any help!
